Checks the head of a branch at
every merge. Checks the stop first;
during a stop it runs no other check,
writes no marker, prints the stop
notice, and exits 1. Then checks the
base, the diff size, and the scope. At
a story merge on story/<id>, reads
the review reports, finding files, and
register files at the branch head with
git, and checks that a code review of
the unit of work ran and that no
blocking finding of it is open. Reruns
every gate and the test suite in a
branch head, with the gate scripts of
result except the result file of
mutation-testing. At the merge of a
feature branch into dev, reads the
ledger and the reports and findings
with run set to the feature branch.
